addons.name: Podcasts
addons.author: MyMediaVault
addons.description: Podcasts via the keyless iTunes Search API. Adds a new 'podcast' media type (its own colour + icon), drills into episodes, and episodes play as audio.

addons.name: AIO Catalog (Worker)
addons.author: cubman3134
addons.description: All-in-one metadata catalog (Movies & TV, Games, Music, Books, Comics, Manga) served from a Cloudflare Worker. A remote addon — installing it just subscribes to the URL; enter your own API keys via Configure. No files are downloaded.
